harnessNotes: Global Teleport stubbing remounted the Provider subtree and hid a configuration snapshot bug behind fresh setup. The corrected fixtures use real Teleport, preserve DOM identity and reproduce 26 failures out of 27, before source changes.

A temporary reference-difference capture was removed after checking every delta against exact permitted busy/hidden/native data additions and the two original historical differences. Original reference baseline files are unchanged.
The first implementation test run failed to collect due to an accidental SVG/comment extraction; it was corrected, was never counted as passing, and the original SVG path was retained.

First rebuilt browser run passed 85/90: native attrs revealed an invalid fixture aria-label on a generic div without a role. The fixture supplies its own region role and preserves the label, native-attrs assertion and every axe rule. The rerun passes 90/90 without adding an implicit component role.

Actual demo theme transition was sampled at a fractional 12.9651px font, producing one transient contrast failure. Both Skeleton and Statistic demo runners now await finite CSS transitions without stopping infinite shimmer or disabling axe rules; all 36 and 28 final combinations pass.
